verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a platform-wide machine-readable OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json (confirmed reachable and containing an openapi key), but there is no evidence this spec specifically documents the Sandbox SDK's methods (exec, readFile, watch, etc.), which are primarily consumed as a code-level Workers SDK rather than a REST API. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Sandbox-specific endpoints/methods are represented in the OpenAPI spec, and a dedicated sandbox-only machine-readable spec or SDK-level type definitions download.
